protocol.name: M1_TRIGGER_FEATURES_AND_ONE_PROGRESS_FILTER_V1
protocol.reference: 123 entered unique M1 volume50 signals in m1-trend-context-2026-11-15.json; unchanged entries, size, initialSL,TP,costs and4h horizon. No BE or failed-break exit.
protocol.training: Confirmation signal before2026-11-01T00:00:00-03:00;66 entries. Descriptive median/IQR byTP versusSL; open cases separately.
protocol.verification: Confirmation signal from2026-11-01T00:00:00-03:00;57 entries. Already examined by preceding experiments, not untouched holdout.

features.volume_pair_relative20: Mean volume of first/second M1 divided by mean20M1 beforefirst; no future minute volume

protocol.single_candidate: Keep only side_sign*(second.close-first.close)>=0. Equality passes. This exact natural zero threshold fixed before feature/performance output. No feature or threshold selection by best result.
protocol.timing: first.ts=signal-120,second.ts=signal-60,both end<=confirmation signal. Gate adds no candle. Discarded budget staysidle; no reshuffling signals or quantities.
protocol.metrics: Original TP,SL,open plus mark-at4h; retained/rejected outcomes and R; total markedR across all attempts (rejected0) avoids inflating per-kept averages. No portfolioROI.
protocol.screen: Promising only if markedR and closedprofitfactor improve overall, markedR no worse in verification week and train week, and at least20 verification entries retained; still requires genuinely new data for promotion.
limitations: Retrospective shared source already used in many experiments; no prospective validation.
